name: Contagion Crisis
source:
Two sisters, Sarah and Ava, are caught in the middle of an epidemic that turns people into lust filled monsters. The pair will traverse the urban city while attempting to avoid getting caught by those contagious with the plague. They will encounter infected humans along their perilous journey who are eager to spread that which controls them. Once they reach the safe zone, they will unravel the mystery of the cause of the outbreak and fight against those that have done them wrong. The story will explore Sarah and Ava's relationship as family. The trial ahead will test their bond: either bringing them closer together or breaking them apart.

translation:
莎拉和艾娃两姐妹陷入了一场将人们变成充满欲望的怪物的流行病之中。两人将穿越城市，同时试图避免被瘟疫传染者抓住。他们在危险的旅程中会遇到被感染的人类，这些人类渴望传播控制他们的病毒。一旦到达安全区，他们将揭开疫情起因之谜，并与那些对他们做错事的人进行斗争。这个故事将探讨莎拉和艾娃的家庭关系。即将到来的审判将考验他们的关系：要么让他们更亲近，要么让他们分开。
